_comment: Group item for the GarminHomeAssistant watch app (house-of-abbey). Add this object to the 'items' array of your menu.json. Shows the latest reading plus the daily average for each of the last 7 days ('--' = no reading). After editing menu.json, add/bump a ?v=N query on the menu URL in the app settings, because HA serves /local files with a 31-day cache.

items.name: Today
items.content: {% set day = (now() - timedelta(days=0)).date() | string %}{% set r = (state_attr('sensor.blood_pressure_log','readings') or []) | selectattr('t','search','^' ~ day) | list %}{% if r %}{{ (r | map(attribute='s') | sum / r | count) | round(0) | int }}/{{ (r | map(attribute='d') | sum / r | count) | round(0) | int }}{% else %}--{% endif %}
